thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: HIGH - Pod evictions detected on us-west-2 serving fleet (severity: P1). Alert group: runtime-evictions. Multiple model-cache pods evicted due to ephemeral-storage pressure. Dashboard: https://monitoring.redwood/alerts/evictions

maria: Oncall here, acknowledging. Paging SREs. Which nodes? any customer impact yet?

jon: I see a cluster-wide spike. Quick `kubectl get pods -A | grep Evicted` shows ~8 modelcache pods evicted across 3 nodes. Some serve-runtime pods in CrashLoopBackOff.

liam: Paste from one pod describe:
```
Name:         modelcache-7f6c9d6b9f-xj2kq
Namespace:    runtime
Status:       Evicted
Reason:       Evicted
Message:      The node was low on resource: ephemeral-storage.
Events:
  Type    Reason     Age   From               Message
  ----    ------     ----  ----               -------
  Normal  Scheduled  2h    default-scheduler  Successfully assigned runtime/modelcache-... to ip-10-1-5-72
  Warning Evicted    1h    kubelet            The node was low on resource: ephemeral-storage.
```

eve: Checked node disk: `ssh node/ip-10-1-5-72` then `df -h /var/lib/kubelet` shows 98% used. `du -sh /var/lib/kubelet/pods/* | sort -h | tail` shows large dirs for modelcache and some old crash logs. Looks like modelcache writes unbounded logs to /var/log/modelcache/*.log (rotated poorly).

maria: Running quick triage commands on node to identify big files:
```
sudo du -sh /var/log/modelcache/* | sort -h | tail -n 20
sudo du -sh /var/lib/kubelet/pods/* | sort -h | tail -n 20
```
I can ssh and remove old crash logs if we need an immediate free up.

liam: Immediate mitigations (short-term):
- SSH -> remove orphaned large logs in /var/log/modelcache/ older than 7d: `sudo find /var/log/modelcache -type f -mtime +7 -delete`
- Force restart modelcache pods on the affected nodes so scheduler can place them on nodes that have space: `kubectl delete pod -n runtime <pod>`
- As fallback, cordon node and evict non-critical pods to free ephemeral.

maria: I'll do the log cleanup on ip-10-1-5-72 now and delete one modelcache pod to reprovision.

(maria ran)
```
ssh ubuntu@ip-10-1-5-72
sudo find /var/log/modelcache -type f -mtime +3 -exec du -sh {} \; -exec rm -f {} \;
sudo systemctl restart rsyslog || true
kubectl -n runtime delete pod modelcache-7f6c9d6b9f-xj2kq
```

maria: Freed ~120G on that node, modelcache pod rescheduled on ip-10-1-12-19 and came up healthy. Eviction alerts dropped for that node.

incident-bot: Alert update: eviction count reduced from 8 -> 3 in last 10m.

jon: We still have 2 nodes with >90% usage (ip-10-1-3-44, ip-10-1-9-21). Suggest we do the same cleanup there and then run a more durable fix.

product-cs: Customer impact check: API error rate for generation endpoints spiked to 6% and 95th latency doubled for ~20 minutes during peak. Roughly 12% of serving capacity was offline. Notified impacted customers: acme-co, brightai, prod-ml. No major revenue-impacting SLAs breached yet but some degraded latency.

liam: Root cause summary (preliminary): modelcache processes write large cache artifacts and verbose crash logs to ephemeral paths, and a recent rollout increased logging verbosity accidentally. Combined with no logrotate / no storage requests leads to node disk saturation -> kubelet evicts pods.

maria: Agreed. For immediate stabilization we did targeted deletions and restarts. Longer-term actions proposed:
- Create a ticket to add ephemeral-storage requests/limits for modelcache (owner: liam, due: 48h)
- Add logrotate in image or sidecar, and ship a small patch to reduce log verbosity (owner: eve, due: 72h)
- Migrate model cache to a PVC or hostPath with eviction protection for high-availability nodes (owner: infra, create RFC)
- Add node-level cron cleanup for orphaned files as temporary mitigation (owner: maria, due: 24h)
- Add alerting runbook to incident docs (owner: sre-oncall, due: 24h)

sre-oncall: Taking the handoff. Summary for next oncall: freed disks on 3 nodes, evictions down, 3 pods still flapping (monitoring). Follow-up tickets: #ENG-4671 (ephemeral-requests), #ENG-4672 (logrotate+verbosity), #ENG-4673 (PVC-modelcache). Links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4671

maria: Posting to #postmortems and creating an incident timeline in the ticket. Will include commands used and exact files deleted.

deploy-bot: Noted: recent modelcache rollout tag v2.3.7 increased debug level. Reverting to v2.3.6 is possible if needed.

eve: One immediate QA/patch we should push: set `emptyDir.sizeLimit` for modelcache pods where possible and ensure container-level `ephemeral-storage` request is set. That will prevent kubelet from global node saturation in the future.

product-cs: Reached out to acme-co and brightai with incident summary and mitigation steps. Asking for any reproduced failures on their side.

maria: Closing active paging for now. If eviction alerts rise again >5 in 10m, escalate to P1 high. Handoff complete to sre-oncall. :white_check_mark: 

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Next action: follow-up ticketing and postmortem required.
